title: Promoted Listings
meta: Promoted Listings campaigns set up for your best items, with ad rates that fit your margin. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: eBay Promoted Listings, set up and tuned
overview: Promoted Listings can help, but a wrong ad rate eats your profit. We work out what you can afford to pay per sale, pick the listings worth promoting, and set up eBay's Standard campaign in your account. In larger packages we add a manual campaign with keywords or rules and review the first results, adjusting rates and pausing weak items. eBay charges ad fees when a promoted sale happens, and we cannot promise extra sales.

faq: How is the ad rate decided?
We start from your item price, fees and profit, then choose a rate that still leaves you money after a promoted sale. eBay may suggest rates, but those are averages, not what suits your margin.
No. Results depend on your price, shipping, photos and demand. We set up and tune sensibly, and we show the real numbers from your account, whether good or poor.
For Standard campaigns, eBay charges its ad fee only when a promoted sale happens, at the rate you set, and adds it to your seller fees. You can pause or end a campaign at any time.
Do you need access to my eBay ads dashboard?
Yes, through account access from your eBay settings. We can see campaign data and change rates, while payment details and login stay with you.
